summary: Iteration 162 - Integrity Mitigation Self-Defense Layer. All tests pass: 4 unit tests (test_integrity_mitigation.py) + 7 API tests (test_integrity_mitigation_api.py) = 11/11 green. Full end-to-end flow verified: login → GET summary returns mitigation block with defaults → create alert rule with mitigation spec → evaluate-now fires rule → summary reflects active mitigation (multiplier=0.5, suppress=true) → cleanup → TTL expiry returns to defaults.
critical_code_review_comments: integrity_mitigation_service.py is well-structured with clear domain boundaries (PRD domain)
Multiplier clamping to [0.25, 1.0] prevents both over-aggressive degradation and amplification
TTL-based expiration with audit trail preservation (rows flipped to inactive, never deleted) is good for compliance
Sync cache bridge pattern for non-async call sites is a clean solution for the position-sizing hot path
data_integrity_alerts.py correctly calls activate_integrity_mitigation + refresh_sync_cache when rule fires with mitigation spec
seed_data_creation: None - test rule (TEST_mitigation_rule_api) was created and deleted during test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Integrity Mitigation self-defense layer is fully functional. The mitigation block in GET /api/admin/data-integrity/summary returns: active (bool), active_count (int), risk_multiplier (float), suppress_strong_signals (bool), items (list). When nothing active: defaults to active=false, active_count=0, risk_multiplier=1.0, suppress_strong_signals=false, items=[]. Alert rules with mitigation spec (action=DEGRADE_TRADING, params={position_multiplier, disable_strong_signals}) activate mitigations when they fire. TTL-based expiration works correctly (tested with 1-minute TTL).

unit_tests.details: 4/4 unit tests pass: (1) multiplier defaults to 1.0 when no mitigation active, (2) activate clamps multiplier and expires via TTL, (3) suppress_strong_signals requires explicit opt-in, (4) multiplier clamps to [0.25, 1.0]

login_baseline.details: POST /api/auth/login with admin@risedual.ai / RiseDual2026! returns 200, sets access_token and refresh_token cookies, returns user data with role=owner

summary_mitigation_block.details: GET /api/admin/data-integrity/summary returns mitigation object with all required keys: active (bool), active_count (int), risk_multiplier (float), suppress_strong_signals (bool), items (list)

mitigation_defaults.details: When no mitigation active: active=false, active_count=0, risk_multiplier=1.0, suppress_strong_signals=false, items=[]

alert_rule_with_mitigation.details: Created alert rule with metric=unknown_direction_tokens, comparator=gte, threshold=0 (auto-breaches), mitigation spec with position_multiplier=0.5 and disable_strong_signals=true, throttle_hours=0, mitigation_ttl_minutes=1

evaluate_now_fires_rule.details: POST /api/admin/data-integrity/alert-rules/evaluate-now fires the rule, activates mitigation

active_mitigation_state.details: After rule fires, summary shows: active=true, active_count>=1, risk_multiplier=0.5, suppress_strong_signals=true, items contains mitigation with source_rule_id, type=DEGRADE_TRADING, params matching configured values

ttl_expiration.details: After 1-minute TTL expires, mitigation state returns to defaults (active=false, risk_multiplier=1.0, etc.)

cleanup.details: Test rule deleted via DELETE /api/admin/data-integrity/alert-rules/{rule_id}, mitigation rows auto-expire via TTL (audit trail preserved)
